# BetterGov Sorsogon

> An unofficial, community-maintained information portal for the Province of Sorsogon, Philippines (Bicol Region). Not affiliated with any government office. Forked from the open-source BetterGov.ph (CC0). All information should be verified with the relevant office before transacting.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sorsogon.bettergov.ph/): Overview of the Province of Sorsogon.
- [Services](https://sorsogon.bettergov.ph/services): How to transact with provincial and local government offices.
- [LGU Directory](https://sorsogon.bettergov.ph/directory): The provincial capitol and the cities and municipalities of Sorsogon, with officials and contact information.
- [Emergency Hotlines](https://sorsogon.bettergov.ph/hotlines): Emergency and public-service contact numbers across the province.
- [Disaster Preparedness Guide](https://sorsogon.bettergov.ph/disaster): Typhoon, flood, and hazard preparedness information for residents.
- [Tourism](https://sorsogon.bettergov.ph/tourism): Destinations, festivals, and travel guidance.
- [About](https://sorsogon.bettergov.ph/about): About this portal and its community maintainers.

## Notes

- This is an unofficial civic-information project. It is not an official government website.
- Content is community-maintained and may be incomplete or out of date.
- Source information is public domain unless otherwise specified.
